shorts.title: GTA 6 Frame Rate: 30 or 60 FPS?
shorts.description:
Rockstar says GTA 6 runs at 30 FPS on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A 60 FPS mode isn't confirmed yet.
Does 30 vs 60 matter to you? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts

shorts.title: GTA 6 Box Copies Have No Disc Inside
shorts.description:
GTA 6 physical copies come with a download code in the box, not a disc, on PS5 and Xbox. You still download the whole game.
Box or digital, which did you get? #gta6 #gtavi #shorts
